prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished full-color American comic-panel feature introduction poster for the existing Chinese app 同拍 / ONEBEAT, portrait 2:3 ratio, high resolution suitable for a full-screen scrollable image inside the 畅游月卡 subscription plan. Target 1536×2304 or higher at the same ratio. This is the NEW multi-style PRO drum machine, not the old single-style editor. Finish as a polished commercial comic print, with readable Chinese UI and a lively narrative flow.

Input reference roles:
Image 1 = OLD approved comic poster. Preserve its brand, characters, bold American comic visual language, generous halftone dots, black ink outlines, dramatic panel gutters and punchy color. Its UI and feature descriptions are OUTDATED: redesign the content.
Image 2 = layout reference for multi-style section cards and grid of saved arrangements, NOT an exact current screenshot. Important latest corrections below supersede its black header, top-right save, and old “我的节奏” label.
Image 3 = original 条纹步客 character identity: cyan-blue skin, turquoise knit beanie, dark green hair, black-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt, purple/orange elbow pads, blue shorts, red sneakers.
Image 4 = original Wave character identity: fair skin, purple-and-pink bob, large black eyes, yellow short overalls over cyan shirt, colorful sneakers.
Preserve these EXACT character designs; no new clothes, skin colors, helmets, anatomy changes or new mascots. Repose them naturally pointing at controls, tapping a screen and celebrating.

Visual style: dynamic expressive American comic, beautiful crisp pen-and-ink, plentiful fine coral/purple/teal halftones, diagonal gutters, burst shapes, speed lines and inset close-ups, controlled hand-print texture on paper. Background warm ivory #FFF9EE. Palette coral #FF7056, teal #00C7BE, lilac #BBA6FF, gold #F2C65D, light blue #A9C9F2 and rich black. Solid black hard offset shadows on UI cards, NO soft blurry shadows, NO glass, NO photoreal smartphone product render. Do not turn this into a sterile wireframe or infographic. The two characters should partly overlap panel edges while UI remains unobscured. Asymmetric but orderly FOUR panels labelled 01–04, plus large title and bottom subscription ribbon. All Chinese clear, correct and legible.

TOP TITLE (about upper 17%):
Enormous coral dimensional “PRO”, teal dimensional “定制鼓机”, black chunky extruded shadows. Small existing “同拍 / ONEBEAT” logo top right like image 1. Characters flank title, cyan beanie boy pointing and purple-pink bob girl delighted. Cream ribbon headline exact “把不同风格，编成你的步调”. Small lilac angled sticker “多风格编排”.

PANEL 01 (upper left):
Big number “01”, bold title exact “一首编排，多种风格”.
Two small tags “12 种风格” and “最多 8 个段落”.
Dominant close-up of the NEW multi-style arrangement page, warm IVORY full-page UI with no large black header and no floating outer window. At top: back arrow, “定制鼓机” and small gold PRO badge. NO Save at top right. Below one compact global settings row “拍号 4/4” and “BPM − 120 +”. Next heading row “编排 · 混合律动” with two small matching LILAC buttons “＋新建” and “保存” adjacent on its right. Next three COLLAPSED segment rows: “段落 A ›” with coral tab and right coral “摇滚⌄” chip; “段落 B ›” with gold tab, “4小节” then gold “爵士⌄” chip; “段落 C ›” with light blue tab, “4小节” then light blue “放克⌄” chip. Each has a small × at far right. Style dropdowns align vertically on right. All segment borders rounded about 8px with offset black ink backing, no soft blur. Add a lilac “＋ 新增段落” control below. Caption in a small clean speech balloon exact “风格跟着段落走”. The cyan boy points across the different color rows.
IMPORTANT: NO global row of style tabs; style belongs to each SEGMENT.

PANEL 02 (upper right):
Big number “02”, title exact “选节奏型，搭配加花”.
Large single expanded current “段落 A” editor close-up. Its header has coral slanted segment title tab, coral “摇滚⌄” style chip, small ×. Under it there are EXACTLY FOUR form rows, IN THIS ORDER:
“节奏型  八分摇滚⌄  ▶  ✎”
“重复    −  4  +  小节”
“加花    军鼓短句⌄  ▶  ✎”
“频率    每 4 小节⌄”
Play and pencil are drawn black ICONS, not text buttons labelled 试听/编辑.
A small anchored bubble dropdown opens from the 加花 field, pointing clearly to that field. It has NO title bar and NO bottom instruction. Show exactly three borderless option rows: “军鼓短句 ✓” selected CORAL fill with WHITE text and WHITE tick; “重音滚奏” white fill black bold text; “通鼓下行” white fill black bold text. Bubble has cream outer frame, R8 corners and solid black offset shadow, white options have R6 corners without outlines.
NO old footer “只修改这一段”. Tiny caption in a speech balloon “重复与加花频率，自己定”. Character hand only in lower right, not covering the four labels.

PANEL 03 (lower left):
Big number “03”, title exact “点格子，写你的鼓点”.
Two clear small badges exact “10 种鼓声” and “4 等分 / 3 连音 / 6 连音”.
A close-up of step-grid editor: top line “每拍细分”, three compact buttons “4 等分”, “3 连音”, “6 连音” with 6 连音 coral selected. Show 4/4, FOUR beat groups labelled “1 拍 / 2 拍 / 3 拍 / 4 拍”, SIX equal columns per group, exactly 24 cells across per visible drum row. Only 4 visible instrument rows are enough for legibility: “底鼓”, “军鼓”, “闭镲”, “开镲”; small ellipsis at edge implies other instruments. Mostly cream cells with scattered coral filled beat steps and thin black outlines. Include the restored slim orange vertical playhead across the grid. Cyan finger taps one cell; girl reacts happily from corner. Do not show an impossible 24-step grid spanning only three beats.

PANEL 04 (lower right):
Big number “04”, title exact “存好编排，一起出发”.
Draw a clear small section “我的编排” with TWO SQUARE arrangement cards in a horizontal row, left “混合律动”, right “起步摇滚”. Each has “4/4”, up to TWO style chips and if more styles use “…”: first card coral “摇滚” + gold “爵士” + black “…”, second card only coral “摇滚”. Both have compact outlined “载入” buttons. Small hard offset shadows, no blur.
Below this a prominent action pair “▶ 试听整曲” on white and “应用到队伍 ›” on coral.
At bottom of this panel, a smaller comic inset shows the marching-page BOTTOM drawer, simple recognizable horizontal arrangement cards under headings “本编排” and “我的编排”; first card selected coral with a WHITE tick, next card ivory labelled “夜行律动”. Caption in a lilac speech balloon exact “行进时，也能切换编排”. Do NOT show a global style selector in this marching inset. The two original characters with phones walk together, leaving the screen snippets readable.
Avoid implying Save automatically applies: label storage and apply as distinct controls as above.

BOTTOM BLACK COMIC RIBBON:
Large white Chinese exact “畅游月卡 · 包含 PRO 定制鼓机”, with PRO coral. Small gold starbursts. No price, no fake offer, no purchase CTA, no invented device synchronization or zero-latency promises.
Overall cohesive, engaging and readable, enough white space inside screenshots, energetic halftone outside them. This should look like an exciting updated ONEBEAT comic advert explaining real new product UI, not a minor recolor of the old poster.
